summary.description: One line, shown on the status page.

disagreement.description: Only when resumed with a message from the user that you didn't follow: why. The factory stops and shows it to them.

evidence.description: What kinds of evidence show the cause, strongest first. "code reading" alone is a guess. The details go in files.evidence.

reproduction.description: Reproduced locally, or "on try": in a factory try push (the un-skip push, or the push of your DEBUG commit). You never push to try yourself. The details go in files.reproduction.

widened.description: The race was made wider (a delay, a forced condition) to reproduce it.

files.description: Paths relative to your worktree, under artifacts/.

evidence.description: Markdown: what shows the cause, with links to profiles and logs; if the fix changes the test rather than the product, why the product is right.

reproduction.description: Markdown: how to reproduce the failure: the commands, the environment, how often it failed without and with the fix.

widening.description: A .diff that widens the race to reproduce it, if you used one.

commits.description: Commit shas in your worktree, oldest first. With "needs a try repro": your DEBUG commits, which log and widen the race.

bugDrafts.description: One per bug to file: each with the commits it covers (their messages say Bug XXXXXXX). Separate fixes get separate bugs; commits of one fix share a draft.

commits.description: The shas, as in commits, of the commits this bug is for.

description.description: Markdown: code identifiers (functions, classes, prefs, files, flags) in backticks. For a test failure, link the test's dashboard: https://tests.firefox.dev/test.html?test=<path>.

bugType.description: defect: shipping code misbehaves (crash, race, regression); task: tests, tooling, config, refactoring with no user-facing change; enhancement: new or changed behavior.

feedback.description: Problems with the tools or inputs you used, one entry per problem.

tryRequest.description: Only a try push the user asked you for in a message: what it should run and why. The factory plans it, the user approves it, and you're resumed with the results. Any other is ignored: the stack goes to try as a whole.

coveredBy.description: Only with "left as-is" because a commit of the stack already fixes this failure: that commit's sha.

profiles.description: The profiles of the failing jobs you read (the test's profile_<test>.json.gz artifact of each failing task), each with what it shows. Required before asking for a DEBUG push: what they show and why that isn't enough. If the failing tasks have none, one entry saying so and how you checked.

profile.description: The file or artifact URL, and the task it came from.
